worldcombat.skill.needlearm.summary: Drop low and lunge a step, swinging the thorny arm violently at one target: the swing deals physical damage with a chance to flinch and scatters thorns into the ground, leaving a patch of bramble that keeps pricking and slowing whoever stands in it. Briar form is bigger, longer and sharper; swing form hits harder and comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.0: Swing in close and leave a patch of pricking bramble
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.1: Seal off a patch of ground and make foes go around
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.2: Pin down a target trying to leave your side
The thorny swing deals %1$s physical damage with a %2$s-block arm reach.
It closes %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick.
A %1$s chance to flinch for %2$s; on a hit it leaves a %3$s-block patch of bramble that lasts %4$s.
The bramble pricks for %1$s damage every %2$s; briar form is currently %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.growth.0: From level %1$s the swing rises to %2$s and the bramble lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.preference.b: On: a bigger bramble that lasts longer and pricks harder, but a lighter swing, slower wind-up and longer cooldown — for sealing ground and pinning foes. Off (swing form, default): a heavier swing that comes out faster with a shorter cooldown, but only a small patch of thorns.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before swinging; larger values swing earlier and leave thorns sooner, where the foe can still step away on approach.

On: rank the swing first only when the target is grounded or foes are clustered, and rank a running target lower, saving the swing for when the bramble can catch someone. Off: treat it as a plain melee move with no bramble bonus.
